heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly to partly sunny in the St. Lawrence Valley; otherwise clouds decreasing north and west, increasing south and east. Highs from the mid 50s to around 60, except low to mid 60s in southeastern valleys, and mid 40s to lower 50s in the Adirondacks and St. Lawrence Valley. West to northwest winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly cloudy north; becoming mainly clear south. Lows in the mid to upper 20s, with some lower 30s near Lake Champlain, and some lower 20s northeast and in the Adirondacks. Northwest winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.

heading: Tuesday
text: Mostly sunny south; variable clouds north. Valley highs from the mid 30s to around 40, some lower 30s northeast and in the Adirondacks. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph.
